rule: parse <DOC> blocks / tab-separated lines; UTF-8 else cp1252; re-join multi-line reviews; skip binary files
ignore the tuple when the review TEXT is missing or empty
fill missing title/favorite with '' and author with 'unknown'; keep missing dates as NaT
unescape HTML entities, strip tags/URLs/control chars, collapse repeats, restore missing spaces
drop duplicate reviews (same normalised text within a domain, keep the first)
drop reviews with fewer than 5 words
flag (keep) reviews above the upper IQR fence Q3 + 1.5*IQR
drop garbled/non-English text ('?' share > 30%, or >= 40 words with < 5% English stop-words)
unify the two date formats; drop impossible or unparseable dates
normalise entity names (hotel = file name after the city; car = year_make_model)
equal-depth binning of word_count (10 bins per domain) + smoothing by bin means
